description: Factual questions put to Emma Bovary (the example madame-bovary, English text) to check that the answers are right. expectedOutput is the right answer, read by the accuracy judge (evals/accuracy-judge.json); passageQuotes are phrases of the book that hold it. 20 questions, one from each of 20 evenly spaced passages (passages 17 to 439), written on 26 November 2026 before any search or reply, and not changed after.

items.input: A notary ran away with money he was holding. Whose property was it, and what did the family then find out about that fortune?
items.expectedOutput: That of the widow Dubuc (Heloise), Charles's first wife; it proved far smaller than had been claimed: the house was mortgaged to the foundations.
passageQuotes: the holder of the widow Dubuc's property

items.input: In the early days at Tostes, when Charles rode away in the morning, what did you do from your window?
items.expectedOutput: She talked to him from above and blew at him a scrap of flower or leaf that she picked with her mouth.
passageQuotes: some scrap of flower or leaf that she blew out at him

items.input: At the dinner at La Vaubyessard, which fruits did you see or taste for the first time?
items.expectedOutput: Pomegranates (never seen) and pineapples (never tasted).
passageQuotes: She had never seen pomegranates nor tasted pineapples

items.input: At Tostes you used to see a man walking up and down who lamented his wasted calling. What was his trade, and where did he dream of having a shop?
items.expectedOutput: The hairdresser, who dreamed of a shop in a big town such as Rouen, overlooking the harbour near the theatre.
passageQuotes: the hairdresser, lamented his wasted calling

items.input: On your first evening at Yonville, who was the fair-haired young man who dined with you, and where did he work?
items.expectedOutput: Leon Dupuis, a clerk at the notary's, Monsieur Guillaumin.
passageQuotes: he was a clerk at the notary's, Monsieur Guillaumin

items.input: When you left the house of your baby's nurse, what did she ask you to give her?
items.expectedOutput: Soap, and a pound of ground coffee (then something for her husband too).
passageQuotes: give me just a pound of ground coffee

items.input: When you were playing the virtuous wife and hating Charles for it, what would you have liked him to do to you, and why?
items.expectedOutput: To beat her, so that she might have a better right to hate him and take revenge.
passageQuotes: She would have liked Charles to beat her

items.input: In your restless days you claimed you could do something, and Charles dared you. What was it, and did you do it?
items.expectedOutput: Drink a large glass of brandy; she drank it to the last drop.
passageQuotes: she could drink off a large glass of brandy

items.input: At the agricultural show, who caused confusion by running back and forth to fetch chairs from the church?
items.expectedOutput: Lestiboudois.
passageQuotes: Lestiboudois had brought thither all those that he had moved from the field

items.input: What finally decided you to go out riding with Monsieur Boulanger?
items.expectedOutput: The riding-habit that Charles told her to order.
passageQuotes: The riding-habit decided her

items.input: Whose book did Charles send for to Rouen to study the operation on the club-foot?
items.expectedOutput: Doctor Duval's volume.
passageQuotes: He sent to Rouen for Dr. Duval's volume

items.input: When Lheureux pressed you to pay a bill, whose payment arrived just then, and what was in it?
items.expectedOutput: Monsieur Derozeray's account: fifteen napoleons, which she kept.
passageQuotes: It contained fifteen napoleons

items.input: In the attic, with Rodolphe's letter, what humming did you hear from below, and who was making it?
items.expectedOutput: Binet working at his lathe.
passageQuotes: It was Binet turning

items.input: Homais urged Charles to take you to the theatre at Rouen: which singer was to give only one performance?
items.expectedOutput: Lagardy.
passageQuotes: Lagardy is only going to give one performance

items.input: When you met Leon again in Rouen, he recalled a day when he followed you. What were you wearing on your head?
items.expectedOutput: A bonnet with small blue flowers.
passageQuotes: you were wearing a bonnet with small blue flowers

items.input: When Charles noticed the bouquet of violets after your return, where did you tell him it came from?
items.expectedOutput: That she had just bought it from a beggar.
passageQuotes: bouquet I bought just now from a beggar

items.input: On the way back from Rouen, what did Hivert do to the blind man who clung to the coach?
items.expectedOutput: He gave him sharp cuts with his whip, and the man fell back into the mud with a yell.
passageQuotes: gave the blind man sharp cuts with his whip

items.input: A stranger brought you a bill for seven hundred francs that you had signed. To whom had Lheureux passed it?
items.expectedOutput: To Vincart.
passageQuotes: had paid away to Vincart

items.input: On a ride home in the Hirondelle, what did you throw to the blind man, and what was it to you?
items.expectedOutput: A five-franc piece, which was all the money she had.
passageQuotes: threw him over her shoulder a five-franc piece

items.input: What were the first words Charles read aloud from the letter you had left, after you took the poison?
items.expectedOutput: "Accuse no one."
passageQuotes: Accuse no one
